storefrontApprovalUnavailable: These settings could not be approved. Reload the settings and try again.
storefrontReturnHint: Use a URL on the same HTTPS website and include ?session_id={{placeholder}}.
storefrontInvalid: Enter an HTTPS website origin with no path or port and a valid return URL on that website.
storefrontDnsInstructions: Add this TXT record in your DNS provider. Use the relative record name if your provider appends the domain automatically.
storefrontCopyManually: Select and copy the record from the field.
storefrontDnsUnverified: The current DNS record could not be verified. Reload the settings to confirm the record value, then try again after DNS updates.
signInIntro: A thoughtful place to manage your business. Sign in to get started.
dashboardIntro: Clear information and a solid foundation for what comes next.
businessesIntro: The businesses you have access to.
empty: No businesses are available yet. Contact your platform administrator.
sandboxOnly: Sandbox test only. This does not connect payments or save tokens.
stripeExistingFailed: Stripe account connection failed. Start a new attempt or contact your administrator.
stripeSandboxUnavailable: Stripe connection unavailable. Contact your administrator.
oauthIdentityVerified: Stripe sandbox identity verified. No payment connection or tokens were saved.
oauthStateValidated: OAuth session checks passed, but Stripe identity was not verified.
oauthFailed: Stripe sandbox verification failed. Start a new attempt or contact the operator.
errorOAuthInProgress: A Stripe sandbox verification is already in progress for this business.
addIntro: Create a business and its first owner account.
passwordHint: Use at least 12 characters and share it securely. The owner can change this password after signing in.
changePasswordHint: Use at least 12 characters. You will need to sign in again after changing it.
passwordChangedSignIn: Your password was changed. Sign in with your new password.
recoveryRequested: If an account exists for that address, a reset link will be sent.
errorInvalidReset: This reset link is invalid or expired. Request a new one.
mfaSetupIntro: Use an authenticator app to protect your account. You will need it each time you sign in.
mfaManualKey: In your authenticator app, add a time-based account named Kuzushi Pay and enter this setup key:
errorMfa: That code is invalid or has already been used. Try another code.
errorMfaUnavailable: Two-step verification is temporarily unavailable. Contact the operator.
mfaAlreadyEnrolled: Two-step verification was set up in another session. Enter a code to continue.
mfaBackupInstructions: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your authenticator. They will not be shown again.
discardBackupCodes: These backup codes will not be shown again. Leave without saving them?
mfaReplaceIntro: Enter a new authenticator code or an unused backup code. Your old backup codes will stop working.
mfaReplaceConfirm: Replace all existing backup codes? They will stop working immediately.
mfaRecoveryAdminIntro: First verify the user's identity outside this app. This resets their authenticator and signs them out. Administrator accounts cannot be recovered here.
mfaRecoveryIdentityVerified: I verified the user's identity through a separate trusted channel.
mfaRecoveryConfirm: Reset this user's two-step verification and revoke their sessions?
mfaRecoveryIssuedInstructions: Give this code only to the verified user through a separate secure channel. It expires in 30 minutes and will not be shown again.
discardMfaRecoveryCode: This recovery code will not be shown again. Leave without delivering it?
mfaRecoveryEnterIntro: Enter the recovery code provided by your administrator. You will then set up a new authenticator.
errorMfaRecoveryCode: The recovery code is invalid or expired. Ask your administrator for a new code and sign in again.
errorMfaRecoveryTarget: This account cannot be recovered here. Verify the email or contact the operator.
draftOnlyNotice: Drafts are saved here only. They are not in Stripe and cannot accept payments yet.
publishLiveIntro: Publish a saved draft to create a product and price in your live Stripe account. Storefront checkout is set up separately.
publishLiveConfirm: Publish the saved version of {{name}} to your live Stripe account?
liveCheckoutPreviewHelp: Preview checkout for a published product. Completing payment charges real money.
liveCheckoutUnavailable: Checkout requires a published product and a live Stripe connection with a publishable key.
liveCheckoutFailed: Checkout could not open. Contact support if the problem persists.
liveCheckoutReturned: You returned from Stripe Checkout. Open Manage products and refresh live orders to check the payment status.
publishLiveFailed: Could not publish to Stripe. Check your Stripe connection and try again.
publishLiveUncertain: Stripe may have created the product or price. Contact support to check the result before retrying.
draftLoadFailed: Could not load product drafts. Please try again.
productNameRequired: Enter a product or service name.
priceHint: USD only for now. Enter an amount such as 25.00, without a currency symbol.
productAmountError: Enter an amount from 0.01 to 999999.99 with at most two decimal places.
draftLimitations: Shipping, delivery, taxes, and product variations are configured separately from this draft.
draftSaved: Draft saved. It has not been published to Stripe.
errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errorCredentials: The email or password was not recognized.
errorPasswordUnchanged: Choose a password different from your current password.
errorCredentialsChanged: Your password changed in another session. Sign in again.
errorInput: Please check your information and try again.
errorEmail: An account with that email already exists.
errorRate: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
errorPasswordCapacity: The service is busy. Please wait a moment and try again.
errorAuth: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
